about_the_game:
This application replaces the classic Alt-Tab switcher with a fluid, and deeply configurable suite of tools.

Animated UI: Set backgrounds of the window and Alt Tab Items to Custom Images, GIFs, or Videos!

Custom App Icons: App Icons can be substituted for custom images, including animated ones. (These custom app icons are used universally in this app, including DLC features like app launch animations, and the app launcher)

Total Visual Control: Change everything from shapes and layouts to fonts and colors. Use solid colors or create complex gradients.

Steam Workshop Support: Share your unique designs and download themes from the community for free.

Modular Themeing: Pick and choose which parts you like from different themes.

Improved Navigation: Navigate the Alt Tab menu using keys, mouse clicks, or mouse wheel scrolling.

Searchbar / Filter: Any time you type while the alt tab window is open it automatically begins typing in the searchbar. This acts as a filter (i.e. typing "Th" would filter to windows like "Theme Editor"). For DLC owners, the search bar doubles as an app launcer, using the same apps you have registered with the app launcher itself.
Tags may also be applied to any "App item" (i.e. "Game") and will be included in search filtering

Keep Watching: This feature displays the contents of a given window in a duplicate window, which may become transparent and click-thru on hover. Awesome for single monitor work flows and watching a video while working, or quickly duplicating a screen for a multi monitor setup.

Highly Customizable UI: Precisely control the size, spacing, and flow of application windows within the switcher to create the perfect layout for your workflow.

Blacklist Support: Hide certain windows from appearing in your Alt Tab window at all! (Toggleable)

Lock / Toggle Alt Tab Window: Option to make the alt tab window "toggle on" instead of staying visible only while alt is held.
